## A current view of climate across the Southwest {.hero-title}

Southwest Climate Watch brings together automatically updated maps of weather,
climate, and drought indicators for Arizona and New Mexico.

[Explore current conditions](pages/current-conditions.qmd){.btn .btn-light .btn-lg role="button"}
:::
